prior_evidence: 1. The new SQL worker pool in `src/sqllens/agent/integrations/sql_threads.py` is a module-level `ThreadPoolExecutor` that nothing ever shuts down. Its worker threads are not daemon threads, and `concurrent.futures.thread` installs an exit hook that waits for them, so a query already running delays process exit. With `database.statement_timeout_ms` set to `0`, or on a SQLite connect or lock wait, that delay has no upper bound, so a container stop runs out its grace period and the process is killed instead of exiting cleanly. Neither the module docstring nor the new transport documentation mentions shutdown. (raised by 4/6 agents)
